description.value:
You send a streak of light at a creature within 120 feet, making a ranged tech attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 energy damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has advantage.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the energy damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
